preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through social engineering/compromise)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the mint() function to create new tokens and transfer them to your address. This allows unlimited inflation of the token supply, devaluing existing holdings while enriching the attacker. The attack requires only a single transaction: mint(amount) where amount is the desired number of tokens to create (including 18 decimal places).
